title: No payment found
body: Check the reference and try again.

sections.label: Payment reference
sections.hint: Enter the reference provided for the payment.

annotation: Teller-only lookup result. Preserve the entered reference on return; do not disclose student or request details when no authorized match exists.

title: Payment already confirmed
body: A second confirmation wasn't recorded.

sections.title: Already paid
sections.body: Check the existing payment record before taking any further action.

annotation: Receipt action appears only when the teller is authorized and an issued receipt exists. No Confirm action. This is a duplicate-denied design example, not an executed transaction.

title: Confirming payment…
body: Keep this review open while the payment status is checked.

sections.title: Payment review
sections.body: The reviewed details remain visible during confirmation.

annotation: Design state only. Runtime uses the real reviewed record, blocks duplicate confirmation and waits for an authoritative result. Do not enable a second confirmation from Back.

title: Payment wasn't confirmed
body: Check the latest status before trying again.

sections.title: Confirmation incomplete
sections.body: Your reviewed details are still available. No new confirmed payment is shown.

annotation: Checking status is reconciliation, not a repeated cash-confirm operation. Return to eligible review only after the server confirms that another attempt is allowed.

title: Payment confirmed
body: The payment is recorded by Cashiering. Request progress is tracked separately.

sections.title: Confirmed
sections.body: This receipt view opens only for an authorized confirmed payment.

annotation: Design example. Replace placeholders only with server-confirmed values. Hide an absent receipt identifier. Payment confirmation must not mark the service request Complete.

title: Appointment booked
body: Review your confirmed appointment and contact the office if you need help.

sections.title: Booked
sections.body: Appointment details appear after booking is confirmed.

annotation: Existing-booking example only. Cancel/Reschedule appear only when server-authorized. Remove them from the pre-booking review; never populate a new account with this example.

title: Cancel this appointment?
body: Review the appointment before confirming cancellation.

sections.title: Appointment to cancel
sections.body: Your current confirmed booking remains unchanged until cancellation is confirmed.

annotation: Reuse G06 confirmation structure. Prototype result is illustrative; runtime waits for server confirmation. Do not invent deadlines, eligibility or automatic fees.

title: Appointment cancelled
body: This appointment has been cancelled.

sections.title: Cancelled
sections.body: The cancelled booking remains part of your appointment record.

annotation: Contextual result variant within G09.2, not a new composition family. Runtime shows this only after confirmed cancellation. No Reschedule/Cancel action remains on a cancelled booking.

title: Choose a new time
body: Your current appointment stays booked until a change is confirmed.

sections.title: Current appointment
sections.body: Keep the confirmed booking visible while choosing a replacement.

sections.label: Preferred date
sections.hint: Choose a date to load available times.

options.label: Available time
options.detail: Use a real slot from the office schedule.

annotation: Slot row is a structural placeholder, not configured availability. Enable Review only after a real slot is selected. Preserve actual current booking and selected date across conflicts.

title: Review new time
body: Confirm the replacement time for this appointment.

sections.title: Current booking
sections.body: This time remains reserved until the change is confirmed.

sections.title: Proposed replacement
sections.body: Selected from the office's available times.

annotation: On success G09.1 must display the newly confirmed time. This navigation is a design example, not a booking mutation. A conflict routes to G09.5 while keeping the original booking.

title: This time is no longer available
body: Your current appointment hasn't changed.

sections.title: Choose another time
sections.body: The selected replacement could not be booked.

annotation: This is the reschedule-conflict variant. First-booking conflict omits the current-appointment claim and returns to original slot selection. Do not imply atomic replacement before confirmation.

title: No available times
body: Try another date or ask the office about availability.

sections.label: Preferred date
sections.hint: Choose another date to check available times.

annotation: Existing-booking variant preserves current booking. First-booking variant removes Keep current appointment and returns to Consult. Do not invent capacity or unavailable time rows.

title: Review attachment
body: Check the selected file before continuing. It hasn't been uploaded yet.
annotation: Only a structural selected-file example. Runtime must use actual selection metadata and the correct G04 free/required/pending branch; no uploaded or submitted marker before confirmation.

title: Uploading attachment…
body: Your request details and selected file stay visible during upload.

sections.title: Selected attachment
sections.body: Upload hasn't been confirmed.

annotation: Indeterminate progress unless real byte progress exists. Prevent duplicate upload. Back must not imply cancellation; provide Cancel only if upload cancellation is supported.

title: Attachment wasn't uploaded
body: Your request details are still here.

sections.title: Upload incomplete
sections.body: Retry the upload or choose another file before submitting the request.

annotation: Preserve form data and actual selected file when supported. An upload failure must not produce a submission success or fabricate an uploaded attachment.

title: File access unavailable
body: You don't have permission to open this file.

sections.title: Access unavailable
sections.body: Return to the records you are authorized to view.

annotation: Unauthorized variant: no filename, request reference, owner, fee, preview or other private details. Verified-owner/payment-gated variant is separate: Payment is required before this file can be opened; Go to Cashiering. Do not apply that explanation to an unauthorized viewer.

title: No verified file yet
body: The office hasn't released a verified document for this request.
annotation: Authorized owner context only. Download action absent. Office evidence review and payment eligibility remain separate from document issuance.

title: File no longer available
body: This document is no longer available to download here.
annotation: Use a specific expiry/removal explanation only when supplied. Do not invent expiry dates, regenerate a document, or show stale private URLs.

title: Ready for pickup
body: Bring the real pickup code provided for your request to the issuing office.

sections.title: Demo — not valid for pickup
sections.body: This prototype does not contain a usable pickup token.

sections.title: Manual code example
sections.body: DEMO — NOT VALID FOR PICKUP

rows.label: Pickup instructions
rows.value: Shown when supplied by the issuing office

annotation: Revise existing student/pickup-token. No fabricated scannable QR, real token or copy-to-clipboard action. Actual runtime shows readable real code with QR only when a server token exists.

title: Pickup confirmed
body: This request is complete.

sections.title: Complete
sections.body: The pickup confirmation has been recorded.

annotation: Green check plus Complete. Runtime appears only after atomic server-confirmed token consumption and request completion, never on scan alone.

title: Code not found
body: Check the code and try again.
annotation: No hidden student or request details. Preserve manual entry for correction only where permitted. This state must remain distinct from already-used and expired token outcomes.

title: Pickup code expired
body: Ask the issuing office to check this request.
annotation: No invented expiry duration or self-service regeneration promise. Show request details only if independently authorized.

title: Pickup unavailable
body: Your account isn't authorized to confirm this pickup.
annotation: No student identity, file, token ownership or protected record details. No confirmation or forced override action.

title: Publishing update…
body: Your edited office status and announcement stay visible while the update is saved.

sections.title: Reviewed office update
sections.body: The published office page hasn't changed yet.

annotation: Inline operation block in existing availability editor. Preserve actual edited values and disable duplicate publish/edits while saving. Back must not silently claim cancellation.

title: Update wasn't published
body: Your changes are still here.

sections.label: Office status
sections.hint: The previously published status remains active.

sections.label: Announcement
sections.hint: Keep the actual unsaved announcement text here.

sections.title: Not published
sections.body: Review your changes or try publishing again.

annotation: Preserve real edited field values on recoverable failure. Cancel returns to the unchanged confirmed published value, not an invented local success. Staff office authority is required.

title: Update published
body: The office update is now published.

sections.title: Published
sections.body: Only confirmed office content appears on the student office page.

annotation: Preview must resolve the corresponding office, not a generic different office. Runtime reaches success only after authorized server confirmation. Prototype navigation is not publication.

title: Assign inquiry
body: Choose a recipient you are authorized to assign this inquiry to.

sections.title: Current assignment
sections.body: Keep the current owner until a new assignment is confirmed.

sections.label: New recipient
sections.hint: Choose from the recipients permitted for this office and your role.

annotation: Staff-only assignment structure. Populate actual permitted recipients; none are invented here. Review remains disabled until selection, then shows selected recipient for confirmation; after confirmed save the thread displays the new assignment. Students can select an office recipient but cannot assign staff.

title: Sending message…
body: Your message stays visible while it is being sent.

sections.label: Message
sections.hint: Keep the actual pending message visible here.

annotation: Composer locked against duplicate send; no sent/delivered check before confirmation. Reuse for staff thread with Staff navigation and correct return route. Back does not cancel or discard an in-flight message.

title: Message wasn't sent
body: Your message is still here.

sections.label: Message
sections.hint: Preserve the actual unsent message for correction or retry.

sections.title: Not sent
sections.body: Check your message and try again.

annotation: Preserve recoverable unsent text. Staff variant returns to staff/thread. Do not add persistent drafts, typing, presence or read receipts. If outcome is uncertain reconcile before retry to avoid duplicate messages.

title: allowed chat
body: Choose a file to explain or extract text.
annotation: Editable UI fixture. No provider call, OS picker, automatic success, persisted history or consent change. Allow opens empty chat; Decline preserves ordinary app access. Preserve actual current-session draft/thread/file on picker cancel, removal, replacement and retry. Send stays disabled until approved procedures and provider contract. Verified-cleanup copy requires server evidence. Example result source: supplied Settings screenshot only.
